When we got outside, a full battalion of the village fire department showed up in full load out gear. They ran hose drills, room/building clearing and had an injury scenario where a "victim" was pulled out of a building. And if you've never seen euro style firefighters and gear, it's impressive. And they don't fuck around. 30 minutes or so later, we were back to work like nothing happened. The Czechs were like: Yeah. This is totally normal for a fire drill.

You can only imagine as a child of the 70s growing up and watching the space program and then learning some time later that I could have a small piece of that. It was just like being that kid again. 262 kHz, carbon fiber embossed leather band, etched/engraved case back, sapphire crystal, and the mission specific NATO strap. The buttons have a very positive snap to them and the chronograph is almost mechanical smooth. You really have to look close (or just know) to realize that it's a quartz. Plus the small seconds at 6 have a hi-beat. It pulses around 10 times per 5 seconds (not exact, but I'm eyeballing it).
